items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: Pete Fountain fronted his first band on my little label.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's the old Albert system. It's the Albert, of course. And a wooden clarinet. Right above Rapp, we have young Pete Fountain.
You almost read the label, the make on there, the brand, but I guess we can't see it.
